statement:
The record gives a status of “clear” for Elm and 3rd, but children are crossing right now, so I will stop the van.
The van is stopped at Elm and 3rd because children are crossing. It must wait until the crossing is clear.
judge_text:
WRONG
It states the record's "clear" status contradicts the observed fact that "children are crossing right now, so I will stop the van," identifying the specific wrong value.
